newsitem.title: UK: Euro VGO - low sulphur steady, high sulphur weak.
newsitem.headline: Euro VGO - low sulphur steady, high sulphur weak.

text.p: High sulphur vacuum gas oil was gaining little support from firmer crude. Dealers said buyers were full and most could not take on more material until the start of December.
A high sulphur cargo, that sold earlier in the week at $155 cif NWE, was distressed which was reflected in the low price with a fob cargo heard offered on Wednesday around $153.
Low sulphur VGO was more resilient with barges pegged around $167.50. Dealers said there was little material to make into cargoes.
